rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=2026, rationale=iter-14 NOISE-FLOOR CONFIRMATION (explicitly a confirmation, NOT a ceiling-raiser -- no climbable lever remains): ONE knob seed 42->2026 (a 4th independent seed at the iter-4 ep6 PEAK cfg: ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, val_n16, grad_clip1.0 -> 0.9596). The prompt's first allowed option. Existing val_n=16 seed band: seed42=0.9596, seed123=0.9588 (iter-7), seed7=0.9605 (iter-12), mean ~0.9596, width ~0.0017. A 4th draw turns the seed axis into a 4-point distribution, tightening the noise-floor estimate of the ~0.96 ceiling. Only seed changes vs the iter-4 peak (apples-to-apples; same scored basis val_n=16, so NOT a different read than the 3 prior seeds, unlike val_n which already has both 16 and 24 read). EXHAUSTED levers AVOIDED: lr anchored 1e-4 (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); n_iter HURTS via per-scan overfit, no early-stop (iter-2 n_iter600 0.9553->0.9407); pretrain_epochs ep6 PEAK (ep3->6 up 0.9596, ep9 DOWN 0.9593 iter-10, ep12 down 0.9585 iter-5); unet_c flat (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); grad_clip insensitive in BOTH directions (iter-8 tighter 0.5=0.9597, iter-11 looser 2.0=0.9592); val_n a read knob not a lever (iter-9/iter-13 val_n24 0.9609/0.9607); warm_start LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, kept True NEVER off; the optimizer field is a DEAD knob (warm-start pre-pass + _fit_one_scene HARDCODE Adam, no scheduler hook; activating either needs editing the FORBIDDEN shared solver). Failure mode: per-image U-Net N2I on dense-view 128-angle breast is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED -- the half-angle view-split discards information the full-view 128-view LD-FBP keeps, so each per-scan GT-free fit caps BELOW the LD-FBP baseline (hr=0); a substrate ceiling, not an optimization/capacity one. Hypothesis: seed=2026 lands WITHIN the established ~0.96 band (~0.958-0.961, hr=0), giving a 4-draw seed distribution that confirms the breast per-image U-Net N2I ceiling is real + seed-stable, not a single-draw artefact -- toward the iter-20 ceiling-documentation mandate. A material drop/lift would mean the per-scan fit is seed-fragile (a stability note, still not a climbable lever). Wall: iter-7/iter-12 (same cfg, different seed) ran ~470-605s, well under the 900s/15-min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
